thread:
nate: Heads up — hosted-api p99 climbed from ~120ms to ~820ms around 10:12PT. P95 also elevated. Spikes started right after the 10:09 deploy. Paging infra/rt. Anyone seeing obvious signals?

anya: I see kernel-selector churn at 10:11 in the selector logs, lots of fallbacks to aux kernels for short sequences. Could be mispredicting sequence length and picking a heavy kernel. :thinking:

deploy-bot: deploy redwood/serving@v2.14.3 merged by kim at 10:09:12 (ci-pass) — https://ci.internal/repo/serving/245

kim: I shipped a small change to batching coalesce window in v2.14.3 (coalesce_ms: 5 -> 10) to reduce overhead. Rolling it back now if it's the suspect. @anya any quick confirm?

sahil: KV cache eviction rate spiked at the same time. Prefetch misses jumped, eviction/sec up ~10x. Logs show hot-prefix thrash; a few tenants creating long prefix churn. Snip from logs:

```
kvcache: evict key="user:pref:abc123" reason=ttl_rotate dur_ms=2.4
kvcache: miss key="user:pref:abc123" backend_ms=45
kvcache: evict_rate=1189/s window=60s
```

This would increase latency on cold lookups and amplify queue depth.

maria: Rate limiter buckets also saw short bursts — token refill couldn't keep up with a burst of small requests. Host-group-3 queue depth hit 420 at 10:13, backloging into the runtime. Ops dashboard: p95 410ms, p99 820ms.

ops-bot: current snapshot (10:16):
```
cluster: hosted-api-prod
queue_depth: 420
p95_latency_ms: 410
p99_latency_ms: 820
aux_kernel_pct: 43
kvcache_evictions_per_s: 1200
coalesce_ms: 10
```

aj: Quick mitigation plan: 1) revert coalesce_ms to 5 (kim already started), 2) force kernel-affinity policy -> legacy for hosted pool for 15m, 3) temporarily increase kvcache capacity on hot nodes and enable a short-lived aggressive prefetch for top prefixes. We can run these in parallel. I can push kernel-affinity change:

```
kubectl -n serving set env ds/rt-kernel-affinity KERNEL_POLICY=legacy --context=hosted-prod
# and revert coalesce via rollout undo
kubectl rollout undo deployment/serving-runtime -n serving --to-revision=245
```

nate: Doing the revert + kernel-affinity now. Turning on extra kvcache capacity for host-group-3 (+20%) as well. I'll post updates in 2 mins.

(2m later)

ops-bot: post-change snapshot (10:19):
```
queue_depth: 45
p95_latency_ms: 130
p99_latency_ms: 190
aux_kernel_pct: 12
kvcache_evictions_per_s: 210
coalesce_ms: 5
```

anya: Nice — p99 back to normalish. The aux_kernel_pct drop supports the kernel mispredict hypothesis. Still want to follow up with a profiler run to inspect hot code paths that trigger the selector change.

kim: I'll open a follow-up PR to add telemetry on sequence length histograms feeding the selector and add a safety cap on coalesce window changes.

sahil: I'll correlate tenant IDs from the eviction logs and flag any single-tenant noisy patterns. If we see repeats we should add tenant isolation heuristics.

nate: Thanks all. Action items: kim PR for selector telemetry + coalesce guard, sahil to investigate tenant churn, ops to watch for recurrence and revert plan if p99 climbs. Closing thread unless new signal. :thumbsup:
